title: Source-first runtime contract binding
summary: This iteration binds the runtime interaction-input section order to the source-first v2 presentation contract, so source signal story, source metrics dashboard, status focus, source map, and full inventory cannot silently drift from the configured product order.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source-first v2 contract|source-first runtime contract|source-first IA dashboard|source inventory|source map scan index" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Source-first presentation order should be executable, not only documented.
lessons.evidence: `reportToInteractionInput` now assembles source-first runtime sections from `presentation_contract.source_first_section_order`, and focused tests prove contract override reorders the source story and dashboard.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the same contract-binding approach for future source-first layout refinements.

lessons.lesson: Browser order checks should read the same contract as the runtime.
lessons.evidence: The E2E source-first section-order assertion reads `config/source-display-contract.json` and maps contract ids to rendered section ids before comparing browser order.
lessons.recommended_action: Avoid duplicating source-first order literals in future E2E tests.

lessons.lesson: Inventory detail sections must remain attached to their parent contract slots.
lessons.evidence: The runtime contract keeps source map group sections after `source_map` and inventory group sections after `source_inventory`, preserving the full 154-entry inventory behavior.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future inventory controls non-hiding and grouped under the inventory contract slot.

followups.action: Use the runtime-bound section order when refining the visible source story and metrics dashboard presentation.
